description: Fork of exp212 (E=192, MLP unembedder, val_bpb=1.7710 @ 8K, 78M). Replace V matrix (V2D->Wv) with a per-head V LUT consuming ln_v(x) directly: nap=6, tph=512, n_outputs=E_H=32, n_alt=1, smooth=lut_smooth_mode=True, no SparseScatter (LUT sums tables -> [B*T, H, E_H]). V2D no longer used for V (only for Q, K). Per-block params: removes Wv (280K) -> adds V LUT (6*512*64*1*32 = 6.29M). Total ~114M.
